description: cosiechat interop vectors: every entry must verify / decrypt to `expect`

reject.name: forwarded to a third party
reject.rule: reject unless our address is in the signed `to`

reject.name: unknown sender
reject.rule: sender keyset must be known or attached

reject.name: signature kid names someone else
reject.rule: the signature must verify with the kid identity keys

reject.name: pre-quantum sender under the default policy
older sequence
reject.rule: ignore a lower sequence than the last accepted

reject.name: ratchet with another KEM
reject.rule: announced ratchets must match the identity KEM, carry their id, be public

reject.name: ratchet with a wrong kid
reject.rule: announced ratchets must match the identity KEM, carry their id, be public

reject.name: ratchet carrying its private key
reject.rule: announced ratchets must match the identity KEM, carry their id, be public

reject.name: link request for someone else
reject.rule: a request must name us as the peer

reject.name: accept for a different request
reject.rule: the accept is bound to SHA-256(request)

reject.name: frame under another road key
reject.rule: drop frames that fail road auth
